title: Backpropagate through attention and count its flops
brief: Write the softmax backward rule, chain it into the gradient of scaled dot-product attention, and count the flops of one layer.
hints: softmax_backward: rowsum = np.sum(weights * dweights, axis=-1, keepdims=True), then return weights * (dweights - rowsum). Each row of the result sums to 0.

attention_backward: recompute scores = q @ k.T / sqrt(d_k) (plus the mask) and weights = softmax(scores). Then dv = weights.T @ dout, dweights = dout @ v.T, dscores = softmax_backward(weights, dweights), dq = dscores @ k / sqrt(d_k), dk = dscores.T @ q / sqrt(d_k).
attention_flops: four (T x d)(d x d) products cost 4 * 2 * T * d**2, and the two T x T products cost 2 * 2 * T**2 * d. Return the integer 8*T*d**2 + 4*T**2*d.
